summary: [spec fidelity, P3] The last And of subject.lifecycle.35 says 'an approved brief adopted into a building subject gets none'. subject_lifecycle_35_adopting_an_unapproved_change_warns_only_where_it_matters (crates/canon-cli/tests/brief_scope.rs:447-491) adopts the approved change into a verifying subject (repo_with_subject("verifying")); no test adopts an approved brief into a building one. The Given also lists only proposed, specced and building subjects, while the tests use verifying and shipped. Fix: say 'into a verifying subject' and list the subjects the tests set up.
